study: Wait, and buy only if it held: when the pre-square fires at minute m, wait W minutes; buy at the SIP open of m+W+1 only if the price the desk sees (IEX 1-minute lows) never traded k bp below the signal's IEX close during m+1..m+W. The inverse of the limit-below entry.
registered_at: 2026-10-14 after the close, before any return of this rule was computed on any session.
origin: Limit-below FAIL (docs/studies/LIMIT_BELOW_2026-10-14.md): signals the 10 bp / 5 min limit did NOT fill earned +57.7 bp (half A) / -3.8 (half B) at market vs -65.6 / -22.6 for those that dipped. Those unfilled numbers include the gain during m+1..m+5, which a waiting entry forfeits, and they were seen on the same 26 sessions - so the idea is suggested by those sessions and cannot be graded on them.
prior: Skeptical. Part of the unfilled +57.7 bp is the move this rule waits through. Every earlier timing rule matched random minutes (memory: entry-setups-are-noise-equivalent, wr-triggers-see-no-runway). Two things favour it: the separation was large in half A, and the rule removes the trades the dip predicts rather than picking a new entry point.
data: tools/studies/early_entry_honest.py cache (ai_reports/early_entry_honest/<day>.pkl): board minutes from decision_ledger, IEX + SIP 1-minute OHLC. Forward sessions are fetched nightly by scripts/nightly.sh (16:40 ET, after the close; one line added 2026-10-14).
signal: Every PRE fire as in early_entry_honest / limit_below_study (live pre-square on IEX 1-minute bars, on-board, 09:50-15:30, 15-minute refractory). Reference P = the IEX close of minute m. A signal with no IEX close at m is skipped (counted).

arms.held: Enter at the SIP open of m+W+1 only if every IEX 1-minute low in m+1..m+W is above P x (1 - k/10000). Missing IEX minutes are no dip (live sees nothing there either). Exit at the SIP close of entry+9 (10-minute hold), the last close carried over a missing bar; none past 16:00.
arms.wait_all: Enter at the SIP open of m+W+1 on EVERY signal, same exit. Separates the hold filter from the effect of entering later.
arms.market: Enter at the SIP open of m+1 on every signal (today's entry), early_entry_honest.markout.

primary_cell: W = 5 minutes, k = 10 bp (the exact complement of the limit-below primary cell).
cost: 10 bp round trip on every arm.
statistics: Per day: held_net = mean net of held trades; wait_net, mkt_net = mean net over all signals. lift = held_net - wait_net; held - market = held_net - mkt_net. Day-equal means, day-clustered t (early_entry_honest.day_equal).
graded_read: FORWARD only: sessions >= 2026-10-15 (none of them seen when this was written). One read at the 10th forward session with a usable cache (about 2026-10-28). If UNDERPOWERED there (and only then), one extension: re-read at the 20th. No other looks are graded; the nightly line prints NOT DUE until the 10th.
pass: PASS only if: held_net > 0 with t >= 2.7, AND lift >= +5 bp with t >= 2.7, AND held - market >= 0 (not worse than today's entry), AND >= 60 held trades on >= 10 days. FAIL when any point estimate is on the wrong side (held_net <= 0, lift < +5 bp, or held - market < 0). Point estimates all passing but a t below 2.7, or too few held trades/days = UNDERPOWERED (no evidence either way; extension at 20 sessions; still UNDERPOWERED at 20 = no conclusion, not closed).
in_sample_kill: A sanity floor, not a test (it will almost surely pass given half A's +57.7 bp non-dippers), on the 26 sessions 2026-09-08..10-13 (halves A to 09-24 / B), computed once after the result-skeptic READY: if the lift over wait_all is <= 0 in BOTH halves, the forward run is cancelled (the idea fails even on the days that suggested it). Any positive in-sample number is NOT evidence and is never quoted as such.
information_only: control: the same rule at the harness's later-only random minute of the same name and day (early_entry_honest.control_minute, entry+1..+60), IEX close there as P. If the control's lift >= the signal's, the hold filter is a generic 'quiet five minutes' effect not tied to the signal: a pass then goes to a separate prereg, not to live. The read prints the control lift with its t and an explicit CONTROL >= SIGNAL flag.
SIP-low version of the hold check (not what live sees)
the grid W in {2, 5, 10} x k in {5, 10, 20}: kept share, held net, lift, held - market
kept share of signals (busy-book cost: the operator wants several opens; a rule that keeps 20% of signals is reported as such)
publication lag: held and wait_all entered at the SIP open of m+W+2 (IEX bar m+W lands seconds after m+W+1 opens); report whether lift keeps its sign
signals with an IEX bar in every wait minute only (missing minutes count as held, which favours thin names)
skip counts per call, not cumulative
no_retuning: W = 5, k = 10, the IEX-low check, the 10-minute hold, the 10 bp cost and the read dates are fixed. A different cell is a new prereg on later sessions.
if_pass: Result-skeptic review of the positive, then a live paper A/B (confirm-after-wait as an arm option) with its own prereg.
if_fail: Waiting for a hold is closed at these settings; the dip is not avoidable by waiting it out.
power: In-sample: ~21.5 signals/session, held share 27% (half A) / 57% (half B): 10 forward sessions give ~60-120 held trades. Minimum detectable effect at 10 day clusters (skeptic estimate): held net and lift of roughly +25-30 bp for t 2; ~+18-20 bp at 20 sessions. Smaller true effects will read UNDERPOWERED. At the family bar t >= 2.7 the minimum detectable effect is roughly a third larger (~+33-40 bp at 10 sessions).
read_context: The read prints bot_config.json's last commit (RVOL option A floors go in the evening of 10/14, so the forward board is not the in-sample board) and each forward day's IEX/SIP miss rate (fetch_day caches partial fetches; days over 5% are excluded by load_days).
amended: 2026-10-14 before any score, after result-skeptic round 1 FIX FIRST: extension only after an UNDERPOWERED first read; t-only misses are UNDERPOWERED; power/MDE stated; publication-lag, full-coverage and per-call skip lines; control t and flag; kill renamed a sanity floor; config sha and miss rates in the read.
family: Amended 2026-10-14 before any return: one of four tests on the same PRE signals (with dip_ideas CUT, RECLAIM, ROTATION); t bar raised 2.0 -> 2.7 (Bonferroni at df ~9).
control_note: The control is information here (lift is already measured against waiting on the same signals) while dip_ideas RECLAIM grades its control; recorded as a deliberate difference (skeptic round 2).
